procedures.name: ADHOC S2
procedures.description:
Refurbished Samsung Galaxy S2 (GT-i9100) with a privacy tailored Replicant build. Runs exclusively free software, bundled with uncompromised apps for maximum security, privacy and anonymity. FOSS

Main CPU runs exclusively auditable free/open-source software. All drivers, such as modem or telephony included. Powered by Replicant OS.
Full encryption

All user data fully encrypted, app data and media files included. Strong passphrase requested before OS boot.
Anonymous communications

Over Tor using E2E (end-to-end encryption):
Conversations + OMEMO for instant messaging
K9-Mail + PGP for assyncronous communication.
Private communications

Over the clearnet using E2E (end-to-end encryption):
Silence for encrypted SMS/MMS
Linphone for VoIp
